sovereign_country.strategic_role: 海湾阿拉伯国家自贸走廊、外资100%控股与印度洋海运枢纽

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Specialty Fresh Bakery Master Franchise and Central Kitchen Ops

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman (Muscat Governorate as primary commercial seat; unitary national jurisdiction without sub-state tax distinctions)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law (Sultani Decree No. 18/2019, as amended), Part relating to Single Person Company (Articles 222 et seq.); Foreign Capital Investment Law (Sultani Decree No. 50/2019) for 100% foreign-owned SPC; Executive Regulations of MoCIIP for registration procedures.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), Commercial Registry Department, One-Stop Shop / InvestEasy Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (M&A) together with the Commercial Registration Application (CR) submitted through the InvestEasy electronic platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Single Person Company under the Commercial Companies Law; however, the capital must be specified in the M&A, fully subscribed by the sole member, and deposited in a licensed Omani bank in the company's name. For foreign-owned SPCs, proof of deposited capital is required at registration; escrowed bank deposit rules apply where the foreign investor commits capital before incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1/2025 OF THE SOLE MEMBER OF OMAN BAKERY SPC. By written resolution, the Sole Member hereby: (1) adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association annexed hereto; (2) subscribes to the entire issued share capital of the company as stated therein and authorizes the Legal Representative to deposit the paid-up capital into a corporate bank account; (3) approves the registered office at the address specified in the Articles of Association; (4) appoints [Name] as Director/Manager and [Name] as Secretary pro tempore, with full powers to execute statutory filings, banking matters, and license applications; (5) confirms that no third-party management agreement is required. This resolution is effective immediately upon adoption.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Investment Facilitation Department — InvestEasy Portal (https://investeasy.gov.om)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online name reservation application for the proposed Arabic trade name using the Single Person Company template. Select ISIC 5610 and confirm no conflicting trademark or registered name. Pay the prescribed OMR fee electronically. The reserved name certificate is valid for 180 days.
required_dossiers: Signed name reservation application form
Passport copy of the sole member
Three alternative proposed trade names
Authorization letter if submitted through an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or public policy, resubmit a revised name within five business days; the first resubmission is exempt from a new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Directorate of Notaries, Ministry of Justice and Legal Affairs; licensed Omani notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a local advocate to draft the Arabic M&A. The sole member must execute the M&A before a licensed Omani notary, or before an Omani consulate if executed abroad. The notary authenticates the signatures and the M&A becomes the definitive incorporation document.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic
Name reservation certificate
Passport copy of the sole member
Written subscription decision of the sole member
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization is queried due to incomplete share capital details or signature issues, amend the M&A and execute a corrected version; foreign-issued powers of attorney must be legalized by the Omani consulate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration Filing and CR Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Department, MoCIIP One-Stop Shop / InvestEasy
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the notarized M&A and supporting documents into the InvestEasy system. The registrar verifies legal form, activity, name, ownership structure, and capital deposit evidence. Upon approval, pay the registration fee and collect the Commercial Registration certificate with the company's CR number.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Bank capital deposit certificate or bank confirmation letter
Lease contract or title deed for the registered office
Passport copy and residency status of the sole member
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficiency notices are cleared by resubmitting corrected digital forms and certified attachments within 15 working days; late resubmission requires a fresh filing and fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Tax Card Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) — Taxpayer Registration Directorate / e-Tax Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the CR, register the SPC with the Oman Tax Authority to obtain a Tax Identification Number and Tax Card. Complete the taxpayer profile with the registered address, bank details, and director/manager information. Register for VAT if annual taxable supplies exceed the statutory threshold; otherwise submit a nil registration confirmation as required.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration certificate
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Passport copy of the legal representative
Lease agreement for the registered office
Bank account details of the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the e-Tax registration is queried, update the Arabic registered address and resubmit the CR and lease contract; the OTA will reissue the Tax Card within three working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Food Establishment License and Premises Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality (or the relevant governorate municipality) — Food Safety and Licensing Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the physical premises licensing application for the bakery counter, storage area, and central kitchen. Attach the layout plan, sanitation plan, and menu/product list. The municipality performs a food safety inspection of floors, equipment, and storage. Upon passing, issue the municipal commercial license and the food establishment license.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration certificate and Tax Card
Lease contract or property ownership document
Premises layout plan and sanitation plan
Contractor waste management agreement
Food handler health certificates
Civil Defense fire safety certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If inspection identifies non-compliance, complete corrective works within 30 days and request a re-inspection; the first re-inspection is not subject to an additional inspection fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Civil Defense and Occupational Workplace Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Royal Oman Police — Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority; Ministry of Labour
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for fire safety approval for the bakery retail area and central kitchen. Submit fire extinguisher certifications, emergency exit signage, and electrical installation test reports. After the Civil Defense certificate is issued, obtain the workplace clearance from the Ministry of Labour and register employees with the Public Authority for Social Insurance.
required_dossiers: Completed building fit-out documentation
Commercial Registration certificate
Lease contract
Firefighting equipment invoices and test certificates
Electrical safety certificate
Employee list and residence card copies
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Schedule a re-inspection after remediating fire and structural deficiencies; labor clearance defects are cured by submitting original employment contracts and corrected occupational health records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Environment Authority — Permits and Licensing Directorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the environmental screening questionnaire for the central kitchen and bakery operations. The Environment Authority determines the project category; for a low-impact bakery, registration is issued without a full EIA. If the oven capacity or wastewater discharge triggers a higher classification, submit an initial environmental review through a certified consultant. Obtain the environmental clearance before commissioning industrial ovens and ventilation exhaust systems.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration certificate
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Premises lease or ownership deed
Wastewater and waste flow diagram for the kitchen
Environmental screening questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Authority upgrades the facility to a full EIA category, she repare and submit an EIA report prepared by an licensed environmental consultant; the timeline extends by the required review period, and an interim temporary operating permit may be requested.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) — Industrial Licensing Directorate, in coordination with Muscat Municipality Food Safety Department and the Environment Authority.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Commercial License and Food Establishment License (Bakery / Confectionery Retail and Central Kitchen Operation), plus Environmental Clearance Certificate.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority (formerly Ministry of Environment and Climate Affairs), Oman
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 — Environmental Registration for low-impact bakery/confectionery operations. If the central kitchen exceeds capacity thresholds for commercial food processing or uses high-capacity fuel-fired ovens with significant atmospheric emissions, the classification may be upgraded to Category 2 requiring an Initial Environmental Review, or Category 1 requiring a full EIA Report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater must comply with municipal sewer discharge limits for pH, BOD, COD, oil, and grease; grease traps must be installed and maintained. Oven exhaust and combustion emissions must not cause visible nuisance or exceed Environment Authority air quality guidelines for particulate matter and volatile organic compounds. Solid bakery waste must be segregated, stored in covered containers, and removed by a licensed waste contractor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification must be obtained from the Royal Oman Police Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority, covering extinguishers, alarms, emergency exits, and evacuation signage. A structural load inspection certificate by a licensed engineer is required for oven platforms, storage racks, and walk-in cooling equipment. Workplace clearance from the Ministry of Labour must confirm occupational health and safety compliance, including first-aid facilities, food-grade surfaces, and adequate ventilation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Authority for Taxation, Sultanate of Oman (also referred to as the Oman Tax Authority, OTA); e-portal: https://tax.gov.om
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC) must first obtain commercial registration with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), then apply to the Oman Tax Authority for an income-tax registration and issuance of a Tax Card (TIN) via the OTA e-portal. The same TIN is subsequently used for income tax, VAT and customs declarations. If the SPC exceeds the applicable VAT registration threshold or makes taxable supplies as a non-resident into Oman, it must separately complete VAT registration through the same OTA portal. Foreign owners without a permanent establishment in Oman are not required to obtain an income-tax TIN solely for treasury remittance purposes; however, the SPC must maintain valid commercial registration, bank documentation, and beneficial-ownership declarations to open a local bank account and operate its central kitchen / bakery chain.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No generic check-the-box election exists under Omani law; the SPC is a distinct separate taxable person under the Commercial Companies Law and the Income Tax Law, and its classification is binding on OTA. The SPC may elect for voluntary VAT registration once annual taxable supplies or deductible expenses reach OMR 100,000, may elect VAT grouping with related Omani entities under conditions in the VAT Executive Regulations, and may seek OTA approval of an input VAT allocation method if partial exemption applies. No hybrid mismatch election is available outside OECD-aligned bilateral/multilateral tax treatment for cross-border royalty and master-franchise payments.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration applies when annual taxable supplies exceed OMR 500,000; voluntary registration applies when annual taxable supplies or annual deductible expenses exceed OMR 100,000. Non-resident persons supplying goods or services subject to reverse charge or e-services to Omani consumers are obliged to register if the mandatory threshold is met, with no remote-seller threshold below the statutory registration threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman does not yet mandate real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping for invoices. A VAT invoice must be issued in Arabic at minimum and retained for five years (ten years for tax-card records); VAT returns must be filed and cleared exclusively through the OTA online portal (Muwassal). The OTA may require XML uploads and reconciliation for refund applications and may apply anti-fraud validations on high-risk zero-rated export claims.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: To claim the 0% VAT rate on export of goods, the SPC must evidence that the goods physically left Oman and the Sultanate of Oman, or another GCC VAT territory where the supply is deemed made, and the goods must be supplied to a recipient located outside Oman; the export must be supported by customs declarations and transport documents. For exported or offshore services, zero-rating applies if the customer is a non-resident in a GCC VAT territory, the service is performed outside Oman, and the benefit of the service occurs outside Oman. Master-franchise royalty payments and central-kitchen supplies between Omani SPC and foreign franchisees may qualify for zero-rating only if the services are directly related to export and are not domestically consumed.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayan / Single Administrative Document) showing HS codes, quantity, value and ISIC activity reference
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from Omani territory
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit / SWIFT message evidencing foreign-currency export proceeds credited to the SPC's Omani bank account
Commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin and, where applicable, insurance/transit documents
Consolidated VAT export worksheet reconciling export invoices with customs declarations and, for indirect exports through free zones, Free-Zone Movement/Transit Declaration
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rated export claims are subject to audit by the Oman Tax Authority for at least five years from the end of the tax period and, for VAT, may be reviewed beyond this if fraud is alleged. If customs documentation is incomplete, goods are diverted into Omani or GCC consumption, or the export proceeds are not repatriated to an Omani bank account within 180 days without an OTA-approved deferral, the OTA will assess VAT at 5% on the export value, disallow the export concession, and may impose late-payment interest at 2% per month on the unpaid tax up to a 200% cap, together with an administrative penalty of up to 100% of the tax difference for an incorrect return. For intentional evasion, OTA may impose a penalty of between 100% and 300% of the tax due, suspend or cancel the VAT registration, and pursue criminal sanctions including fines of up to OMR 50,000 and/or imprisonment under Oman's tax evasion provisions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fully convertible on both current and capital account, with a hard peg against the US Dollar at approximately 1 OMR = 2.6008 USD. Oman has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations; therefore, CBO imposes no exchange-control restrictions on current payments for trade, services, royalties, or distributed profits. Capital account transactions for a 100% foreign-owned Omani Single Person Company (SPC) are permitted under the Foreign Investment Law; capital inflows and outflows are liberalised, subject to CBO statistical reporting, anti-money laundering verification, and compliance with commercial registration evidence. Profit remittance hates are minimal: the main hurdle is a 10% withholding tax on dividends and certain service/royalty charges under the Income Tax Law (reduced where a tax treaty applies), plus a certificate of tax clearance or proof that withholding tax is satisfied. No CBO or Currency Law approval is required to repatriate directors' or shareholders' equity capital, provided the company is licensed and its obligations to employees, lenders, and the Oman Tax Authority are satisfied.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman does not impose a statutory export proceeds surrender requirement or mandatory conversion ratio under CBO exchange-control rules. Exporters, including a bakery franchise central kitchen, may lawfully retain export proceeds in foreign-currency accounts with an authorized Omani bank or use them to settle imports. There is no fixed timeline for repatriation into Oman. The only compliance layer is that such receipts must be captured correctly in the company's audited financial statements and in the CBO balance-of-payments statistical reporting generated by the servicing bank; the bank may require documentary proof (commercial invoices, packing lists, customs declarations) before releasing or crediting unusually large export receipts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Paid-up Capital) / Operational Current Account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Medium as a supplementary collection and procurement conduit, but Low as the primary treasury infrastructure. Offshore electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as Wise or debit-style corporate platforms are not licensed by CBO, do not hold OMR deposit-taking licenses, and cannot provide Omani local account numbers or access to the national retail clearing infrastructure. They may be used to aggregate cross-border franchise royalty payments from overseas stores and to make USD/EUR/CNY supplier payments, provided the EMI accepts a Chinese-owned Oman SPC under its own AML/KYC policy. Legal constraints: holding OMR deposits from Omani residents or performing domestic payment services without a CBO Payment Service Provider license is a breach of the banking and payment system regulations; therefore, the EMI must be restricted to non-OMR, non-resident-facing flows. All local-to-local OMR flows, VAT payments, employee salaries, and Omani franchisee POS settlements must be cleared through a licensed Omani bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandated for the initial onboarding file. CBO AML/CFT directives require authorized banks to positively identify legal entity signatories, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs). For a foreign-owned SPC, the foreign director/shareholder should either attend an in-person interview at the Omani bank, or grant a notarized and diplomatically legalized Power of Attorney to a resident General Manager. Remote opening is possible only in limited circumstances where the bank has previously onboarded the UBO or has a valid CBO Sanbox/digital-KYC approval; most tier-1 Omani banks will nevertheless require an initial physical interview or notarized legalization before issuing an OMR IBAN. A practical, fully compliant structure is to use a resident General Manager as signatory, supported by apostilled/consular-legalized constitutional documents, Commercial Register extract, SPC license, and source-of-funds evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Non-resident Chinese individual UBO with no Omani Civil ID, recent formation of the SPC, and a banking relationship originating in mainland China.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO declaration in CBO-standard form; certified constitutional documents (Commercial Companies Law registration, SPC articles of association); Commercial Register extract and Oman Foreign Investment certificate; passport copy and proof of address verified by a Chinese bank reference; Chinese bank confirmation letter (6-month statements and account conduct); notarized apostille/legalization of powers of attorney; documented business plan and central kitchen franchise model; projected cash flows and source-of-wealth letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Cash-intensive retail bakery franchise with high daily POS receipts, frequent royalty remittances to a foreign franchisor, and a mismatch between declared sales and banking transactions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full franchise licence and Master Franchise Agreement; one-year detailed cash-flow budget; point-of-sale merchant registration documents and acquiring-bank terminal records; VAT filings and tax clearance with Oman Tax Authority; weekly sales and inventory reconciliation from the central kitchen; audited financial projections and unit-level sales model; AML/transaction-monitoring policy for store deposits; explanation of all third-party trade payments, supported by invoices and CBO-compliant SWIFT purpose codes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The only CBO-compliant inbound routing is an international SWIFT MT103 or MT202 credit from the Chinese shareholder's account to the Omani SPC's capital escrow or corporate operating account with a licensed Omani bank. The beneficiary field must exactly match the SPC name as shown on the Commercial Register. The purposes/remittance information field must state “Equity contribution / direct investment in Omani Single Person Company – bakery franchise central kitchen” and include the SPC CR number. The Omani receiving bank will complete its CBO Balance of Payments classification and may request: the Foreign Investment Law license, SPC constitutional deed, paid-up capital declaration, source-of-funds letter from the remitting bank, passport and UBO onboarding pack, and confirmation that the transaction is unrelated to terrorism or sanctioned jurisdictions. Amounts above the CBO threshold are subject to enhanced due diligence. After receipt, the funds must be reflected in the SPC's statutory records; use of such funds to acquire the central kitchen, equipment, or working capital must be documented for the Oman Tax Authority.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade settlements, the primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 for open-account invoices to Chinese and international suppliers, with the instruction field containing the invoice number and the stated corporate commercial purpose. For larger capital expenditures of the bakery chain, an irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit (MT700) issued by Bank Muscat or another Omani bank in favour of the Chinese equipment supplier is recommended; the Omani bank will route via a confirming bank in China. Local OMR payments to employees, landlords, and Omani franchise stores are cleared through the licensed bank's local payment system and the CBO-operated settlement infrastructure; OMR is not deliverable offshore, so any OMR obligation to a non-resident must be converted by an authorized dealer and remitted abroad in USD, EUR, or CNY. All outbound remittances must carry transparent payment purposes and, if above the Omani bank's limit, satisfy routine source-of-funds and recipient-due-diligence checks.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX Forward (USD/OMR and CNY/OMR) through a CBO-licensed authorized dealer under an ISDA Master Agreement; requires demonstrable underlying trade or investment exposure.
Non-Deliverable CNY Forward (CNY NDF) executed offshore or with a licensed Omani bank; net settlement in USD or OMR, permissible because CNY is not a deliverable currency in Oman.
Cross-Currency Swap (CNY/OMR or USD/OMR) for medium-term central-kitchen equipment financing and franchise expansion, subject to normal collateral, credit approval, and CBO reporting.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Register Renewal and Commercial License Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Directorate General of Commercial Affairs, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), Sultanate of Oman
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule - no later than 30 days following each anniversary of the company's commercial registration date; one renewal per calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal attracts OMR 20 per month or part thereof (capped at OMR 200) and additional administrative charges; unresolved renewal beyond 6 months results in suspension of the commercial register and eventual strike-off by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Independent auditor's report and audited financial statements for the previous fiscal year (filed as annexure to shareholder decision)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority (filing) and MoCIIP (maintained for inspection); delivered to the sole shareholder for SPC approval.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of each accounting period (calendar year basis); extension of 2 months available with prior approval from the Oman Tax Authority.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-audit when turnover threshold is triggered constitutes a contravention of the Commercial Companies Law, carrying fines up to OMR 500 and empowering the Tax Authority to treat unaudited statements as incomplete filings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and UBO Confirmation Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (via Invest Oman / e-portal).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Furnished annually with the commercial register renewal, on or before the 30th day of the registration anniversary.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file UBO returns is punishable by administrative fines up to OMR 100 and may suspend shareholder transfers until the filing is restored.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory if gross annual turnover exceeds OMR 50,000 (approximately USD 130,000); required for SPCs if any shareholder or lender requests an audit; always mandatory for banking, insurance, investment and Hajj/Umrah-related activities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by Oman; Oman Tax Authority requires IFRS-compliant financial statements for corporate tax purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: For an SPC, any transfer of the sole quota must be executed by notarized deed and lodged with MoCIIP within 30 days of the transfer; the register of beneficial owners must be updated simultaneously, and an annual UBO confirmation statement is filed on the commercial register anniversary.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 260 - USD 520 per year (OMR 100 - OMR 200) for registered office outsourcing in Muscat.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200 - USD 3,500 annually depending on transaction volume and shared central kitchen operations.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% on taxable income exceeding OMR 100,000; 3% on the first OMR 100,000 of taxable income
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Preferential 3% SME bracket on first OMR 100,000 of taxable income; no automatic statutory tax holiday for bakery franchise operations; possible FDI incentive exemption of up to 10 years only where expressly approved by the Investment Facilitation and Export Development Authority for a qualifying priority project, which is not presumed for the Chinese pastry chain; dividends received exemption available; full deductibility of arm's-length operating costs, depreciation, payroll and central kitchen expenses subject to the Income Tax Law (Sultani Decree No. 11/2023)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Oman Tax Authority Corporate Income Tax Return (Form CIT / Income Tax Declaration integrated in the Emtaat unified e-filing portal of the Oman Tax Authority, portal access via www.tax.gov.om)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months after the end of the fiscal year (statutory deadline e.g. 30 April following a 31 December fiscal year-end); extension may be granted only upon a reasoned application submitted to the Oman Tax Authority before the original deadline

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer Identification Number (TRN) issued by the Oman Tax Authority on registration of the Single Person Company
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Oman-issued TRN of the SPC; the non-resident sole shareholder must not substitute its foreign tax identification number

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Commercial Registration number, legal form (Single Person Company / LLC), and date of incorporation under the Commercial Companies Law (Sultani Decree 18/2019)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach certified copy of the Commercial Register extract showing the foreign sole shareholder; update the register within 10 days of any shareholding change

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year period: start and end dates of the accounting period covered by the return
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the SPC's audited financial year; if consolidated into the Chinese group, the Oman statutory return still follows the SPC's local fiscal year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue: total bakery and pastry sales from all franchise stores, including daily POS takings, delivery platform revenue, and central kitchen sales to franchisees
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All Oman-source retail revenue must be declared in the SPC return; no revenue may be booked in China or in any offshore invoicing entity

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating costs: raw materials, central kitchen rent, payroll, utilities, statutory depreciation and other expenses allowable under the Income Tax Law
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses must be supported by Oman VAT-compliant invoices, bank payment records and payroll declarations; head-office allocations from China are deductible only if arm's-length and properly documented

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Royalty, franchise and management fees paid to the Chinese master franchisor or related parties
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all related-party payments; attach the transfer pricing analysis and proof that 10% WHT was withheld and remitted for the service/royalty component; otherwise the deduction is disallowed

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before loss relief and before applying the statutory rate bands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recompute in OMR; no foreign exchange adjustments that artificially shift profit outside Oman are permitted without a valid TP benchmark

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Carried-forward tax losses utilized: only losses not older than 5 years and arising from the same SPC are deductible
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No part of the Chinese parent's tax losses may be set off against Oman income; loss utilization is ring-fenced at the SPC level

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computation: 3% applied to the first OMR 100,000 of taxable income and 15% applied to the excess over OMR 100,000
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SPC is the sole taxpayer; the non-resident shareholder is not entitled to any pass-through or consolidated group election with the Chinese parent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Transfer pricing declaration, related-party transaction schedule, and the withholding tax summary for payments to non-residents
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the Chinese Tax Residency Certificate and beneficial-ownership statement when claiming China-Oman DTA relief on any cross-border payment subject to WHT

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed administrative fine of OMR 200 plus additional tax at 2% of the unpaid CIT for each month or part of a month of delay; late payment: additional tax at 2% per month on the overdue amount; negligent inaccuracy: penalty up to 25% of the understated tax; intentional non-compliance may attract criminal prosecution with fines of up to OMR 50,000 and imprisonment of up to 5 years

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%: Oman does not impose statutory withholding tax on dividends distributed by an Omani resident SPC, whether to a resident or non-resident shareholder; profits are taxed once at the entity level
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: For dividends no treaty relief is needed because the domestic statutory rate already equals 0%. For royalties and services where the statutory 10% WHT applies, the non-resident shareholder must: (1) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate from the State Taxation Administration of China under the China-Oman Double Tax Agreement (2000); (2) submit the Oman Tax Authority treaty relief application (Form WHT-1) through the Emtaat portal before payment; (3) provide a signed beneficial-ownership statement confirming the recipient is not a conduit and has full legal, economic and risk-bearing substance; (4) retain the TRC, underlying license contract and payment records for at least 5 years; the Omani SPC, as payer, must withhold at the treaty rate only upon receipt of the complete dossier and must remit the withheld tax to the Oman Tax Authority in the statutory collection window of the month following payment
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory royalty, technical and service fees paid to non-residents: subject to 10% WHT on the gross amount paid by the SPC; statutory interest paid to non-resident lenders: not subject to Oman WHT (0%). Under the China-Oman DTA: royalties generally remain subject to up to 10% WHT, so treaty relief is normally nil unless a lower rate is evidenced; interest is likewise covered by the treaty but the domestic 0% statutory treatment prevails, requiring no WHT deduction; shareholder loans bearing excessive interest may be re-characterized as hidden profit distributions under the substance-over-form and general anti-avoidance provisions

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File (TP documentation) is mandatory when the aggregate value of the Oman SPC's related-party transactions during a tax year exceeds OMR 500,000; Master File documentation is required when the multinational group's worldwide consolidated revenue exceeds OMR 15,000,000; Country-by-Country Report is required for groups with consolidated revenue above OMR 350,000,000, aligned with OECD BEPS Action 13 standards
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman has no UAE-style standalone Economic Substance Regulations licence for bakery franchises, but the Income Tax Law (Sultani Decree No. 11/2023) codifies substance-over-form, beneficial ownership, effective management and a general anti-avoidance rule. The Chinese-owned SPC must demonstrate real business substance in Oman: physical central kitchen and store premises, Omani payroll and social insurance, board and management decisions taken in Oman, bank accounts operated from Oman, and genuine operational control over the franchise network. A paper-only SPC with management exercised from China will be treated as a conduit, denied tax deductions and DTA benefits, and exposed to re-characterization of its profit flows

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through Cash Suppression and POS Manipulation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting bakery store cash sales from the POS system, issuing fake refund vouchers, operating unregistered secondary tills, or misclassifying Chinese pastry sales as exempt items to keep Oman taxable income below the OMR 100,000 band and evade the 15% corporate income tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative additional tax of 100% of the evaded CIT; fixed penalties of OMR 5,000 to OMR 50,000; monthly 2% surcharge on underpaid tax; criminal conviction for tax fraud with imprisonment of up to 5 years; blacklisting from government contracts and revocation of economic operator status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under the Commercial Companies Law and the Income Tax Law, the sole shareholder and resident director-manager may be jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt where they instigated or knowingly benefited from the under-declaration; court-ordered travel ban, attachment of personal bank accounts, freezing of personal assets, and imprisonment of up to 5 years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Non-Compliance on Master Franchise Royalty Flows
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying a materially inflated royalty or central kitchen management fee to the Chinese master franchisor (e.g., 7% of gross revenue where the arm's-length benchmark under CUP is 3%), failing to prepare or file the Local File and TP disclosure, or routing know-how fees without withholding and remitting the statutory 10% WHT
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-determination of taxable income at arm's length and disallowance of the excess royalty; additional tax at 2% per month on the underpaid CIT; penalty of up to 25% of the understated tax; separate fines of up to OMR 5,000 for failure to produce TP documentation; possible double taxation exposure on the same royalty in China and Oman
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the sole shareholder who sign false transfer pricing declarations are personally liable for fines of up to OMR 20,000 and disqualification from serving as directors for up to 3 years; repeat or wilful conduct escalates to criminal liability and extra-territorial exposure under the tax information exchange and mutual assistance framework

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Structure and Sham SPC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the SPC as a bare invoicing conduit for the Chinese franchisor: no Omani central kitchen or store substance, no local payroll, board meetings and management decisions taken in Shanghai, nominee Omani shareholder concealing the true beneficial owner, and using the SPC to park franchise fees while the economic activity remains outside Oman
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disregard of the SPC for tax purposes, denial of limited liability, cancellation of commercial registration, disallowance of all claimed deductions, re-characterization of remittances as deemed dividends or disguised profit distributions, and penalties of up to OMR 100,000 under the Commercial Companies Law for nominee shareholding abuses
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing of the corporate veil makes the Chinese sole shareholder personally liable for all corporate debts, unpaid taxes and penalties; the Omani nominee shareholder faces criminal liability for false declarations and enabling unlawful foreign control, a 10-year entry ban on company management, and confiscation of fees received for the nominee arrangement

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Trade-Based Money Laundering through Bakery Cash Flows
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring daily POS cash proceeds into repeated bank deposits deliberately kept below OMR 3,000 to avoid currency transaction reporting, issuing fake central kitchen supplier invoices to move liquidity abroad on wire transfers labeled as 'master royalty', or accepting unexplained third-party payments into the SPC account to layer funds for the benefit of the Chinese parent
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under the Oman Anti-Money Laundering Law (Sultani Decree 24/2016 as amended): fines per breach of up to OMR 20,000, imprisonment of up to 7 years for money laundering, asset forfeiture equal to the value of the laundered funds, freezing orders, and mandatory revocation of the commercial licence and POS merchant registration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Director-level criminal exposure for signing or approving false invoices and structuring instructions; travel bans and no-exit orders issued at the request of the Public Prosecutor; personal confiscation of proceeds; prohibition from opening or operating bank accounts in Oman for up to 5 years; and potential extradition under bilateral judicial cooperation treaties
